accordion.markup_template:
<section class="accordion">
  <details open>
    <summary>Overview</summary>
    <section>Overview content.</section>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>More</summary>
    <section>More content.</section>
  </details>
  <details aria-disabled="true">
    <summary>Unavailable</summary>
    <section>Unavailable content.</section>
  </details>
</section>
accordion.composition_rules: Open: details has open; closed: omit open. aria-disabled=true prevents toggling. One item opens at a time; data-multiple on .accordion allows several. Wrong: replace native details/summary with div/button and invented data-state attributes.

alert.markup_template:
Heads up!

You can add components and dependencies to your app.
alert.composition_rules: Use data-variant="destructive" for errors. Optional direct child footer aligns actions inline-end. Wrong: use role="alert" on a div without the alert class or omit the section wrapper for body text.

alert-dialog.markup_template:
Are you absolutely sure?

This action cannot be undone.
alert-dialog.composition_rules: Native dialog with alert-dialog class; no Basecoat JS. Omit dismiss controls when the user must choose explicitly. Wire showModal() from a trigger; check returnValue on close. Wrong: use class="dialog" alone or backdrop click to dismiss a destructive confirm.

avatar.composition_rules: Image first, fallback span after. data-size="sm" or data-size="lg" for alternate sizes. avatar-badge for status dot. avatar-group wraps overlapping avatars. Wrong: put initials before img or omit alt on the image.

badge.composition_rules: Use short text for status. Do not rely on color alone or use a badge as a primary action.

breadcrumb.composition_rules: nav.breadcrumb with aria-label="Breadcrumb". Mark current page with aria-current="page". Separators use li[aria-hidden="true"]. Wrong: use a div instead of nav/ol or skip aria-current on the current item.

button.composition_rules: One primary action per task group. Use data-variant="outline" for Cancel; group actions with gap-2 and separate the group with gap-6.

button-group.composition_rules: Wrap related btn controls sharing outer radius. data-orientation="vertical" stacks controls. hr[role="separator"] divides groups. Wrong: nest unrelated standalone buttons without the button-group wrapper.

card.composition_rules: Never nest a card inside a card. Use flat sections or dividers for inner groups. Keep one primary action per card.

chart.markup_template: A: 3; B: 5.
chart.composition_rules: Requires app-supplied Chart.js on window.Chart before initialization. Basecoat does not bundle it. Use a canvas inside .chart with an accessible label and text alternative. No open/closed/disabled state. Wrong: assume data-chart-data or initAll() initializes charts; call basecoat.chart() explicitly.

checkbox.composition_rules: Checkbox uses class="input" on input[type="checkbox"]. Pair with field and label. data-disabled on field mirrors disabled input. Wrong: add role="checkbox" on a div or omit the label association.

combobox.markup_template:
Alpha
Beta
combobox.composition_rules: Closed: aria-expanded=false, aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Runtime manages aria-selected, aria-activedescendant and option aria-hidden for filtering. Disable text input with disabled; options with aria-disabled=true. Wrong: replace the hidden value input with a name on the search input.

command.markup_template:
Open
Unavailable
command.composition_rules: Standalone command stays expanded. Modal variant: dialog.command-dialog wraps .command; use showModal()/close(). Disabled items: aria-disabled=true. Runtime manages active, aria-activedescendant and filtered aria-hidden. Bind application actions. Wrong: use listbox/option instead of menu/menuitem.

dialog.markup_template:
Confirm action

Review the consequences before continuing.
dialog.composition_rules: Native dialog: no Basecoat JS. Listen for close and check returnValue === 'confirm' before performing the action; this template only closes. Keep Cancel focused; no nested card.

drawer.markup_template:
Details

Panel content.
drawer.composition_rules: showModal() sets native open; close() animates with data-closing then clears open. Keep one inner surface. Escape/backdrop close via the controller. Native disabled blocks trigger buttons; no drawer disabled state. Wrong: use a div.drawer or invent data-open-drawer behavior.

dropdown-menu.composition_rules: Keep trigger, popover and menu in one wrapper with matching IDs. Preserve menu roles and keyboard behavior. Bind application actions to menu items.

empty.markup_template:
No records yet

Create a record to get started.
empty.composition_rules: Explain why content is absent and offer one useful next action. Keep the state in its content region; do not wrap it in nested cards.

field.markup_template: Write a short message.
field.composition_rules: One control per field. data-orientation="horizontal" or responsive flips label beside control. fieldset/fieldset groups related fields. Wrong: stack multiple unrelated inputs in one field without a group legend.

input.markup_template: Use your work email.
input.composition_rules: Keep the label visible. Use gap-2 within each field, gap-4 between fields and gap-6 before actions. Associate errors using aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

input-group.markup_template: ⌕ 12 results
input-group.composition_rules: Native input/textarea/select stay borderless children. data-align="start|end" places addons; data-orientation="vertical" uses header/footer rows. Wrong: wrap the control outside input-group or omit aria-hidden on decorative icons.

item.markup_template:
Record title

Supporting details.
item.composition_rules: One item is one row inside item-group, not a card grid. Repeat sibling items for a list; keep content in section and trailing actions in aside.

kbd.composition_rules: Use kbd.kbd per key cap. Group combos with inline-flex and + text between keys. Wrong: style shortcuts with code or span alone without the kbd class.

label.composition_rules: Apply label class on native label. for must match control id. Can wrap checkbox/radio inside label. Wrong: replace label with a bare span for visible field names.

native-select.markup_template:
<select class="select" aria-label="Fruit">
  <option value="">Select a fruit</option>
  <option value="apple">Apple</option>
  <option value="banana">Banana</option>
</select>
native-select.composition_rules: Native select uses class="select" (not the JS custom select). Provide aria-label or an associated label. disabled on select blocks interaction. Wrong: reuse the custom .select div/listbox markup for a native element.

popover.markup_template:
Details

Supporting information.
popover.composition_rules: Closed: trigger aria-expanded=false, content aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Native disabled on the trigger blocks activation. Wrong: wrap the trigger or data-popover in another element; both must be direct children of .popover.

progress.composition_rules: One child span width matches aria-valuenow. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby. Wrong: use progress element without the progress class or omit aria-valuenow on a determinate bar.

radio-group.composition_rules: Radios use class="input" with a shared name. Wrap in role="radiogroup" or fieldset with legend. field+section adds descriptions. Wrong: give each radio a different name or skip the group landmark.

scroll-area.markup_template: Your scrollable content here.
scroll-area.composition_rules: Apply scrollbar or scrollbar-sm on an element that already uses overflow-auto/y/x. CSS-only; no JS wrapper. Wrong: expect scroll-area to create overflow without overflow utilities on the same node.

select.markup_template:
Alpha
Beta
select.composition_rules: Closed: aria-expanded=false, aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Selected option: aria-selected=true; runtime sets aria-activedescendant. Disable trigger with disabled; options with aria-disabled=true. Wrong: omit the direct-child hidden input or trigger span.

sidebar.markup_template: • Home
sidebar.composition_rules: open()/close()/toggle() manage aria-hidden and inert: closed=true+inert; open=false without inert. Initial state uses data-initial-open and data-initial-mobile-open. Native disabled blocks buttons. Keep page content immediately after .sidebar. Wrong: invent data-sidebar-toggle; bind the trigger to toggle().

skeleton.composition_rules: skeleton plus sizing utilities shapes placeholders. Mark decorative blocks aria-hidden when adjacent text explains loading. Wrong: use skeleton as a live content container without aria-busy on the updating region.

slider.markup_template: <input type="range" class="input w-full" min="0" max="100" value="50" />
slider.composition_rules: Native input[type="range"] with class="input". range.js sets --slider-value on input events. Single thumb only; no vertical or multi-thumb API. Wrong: import basecoat-css/slider or omit the range module while using type="range".

switch.composition_rules: Switch is input[type="checkbox"] with role="switch" and class="input". checked/disabled/aria-invalid follow native state. data-size="sm" shrinks track. Wrong: use role="switch" on a div or a button element.

table.markup_template:
Recent invoices
InvoiceAmount
INV-001$250.00
table.composition_rules: Use a table for comparable records; no card per row. Keep labels start-aligned and numbers end-aligned. Place the toolbar gap-4 above. Keep overlays outside the scrolling container.

tabs.markup_template:
Overview content
History content
tabs.composition_rules: Use tabs for peer views, not sequential steps. Keep panels flat; use gap-6 between content groups. Preserve matching IDs, hidden state and keyboard navigation.

textarea.composition_rules: textarea class on native textarea; field wrapper styles nested textareas too. disabled and aria-invalid="true" for states. Wrong: use input type="text" for multiline copy or omit label in a field group.

theme-switcher.composition_rules: Requires basecoat runtime for window.basecoat.theme.toggle(). Pair sun/moon icons with dark:hidden/dark:block. Add inline pre-CSS themeMode script to avoid flash. Wrong: import basecoat-css/all or a nonexistent theme-switcher module.

toast.markup_template:
Saved

Changes saved.
toast.composition_rules: Use one #toaster. Open: aria-hidden=false; close() sets true then removes the toast after transition. data-duration=-1 disables timeout. Footer buttons/links dismiss; native disabled blocks buttons. Error category uses role=alert. Wrong: rename #toaster or add a fake data-toast-trigger attribute.

tooltip.markup_template: <button class="btn" data-variant="outline" data-tooltip="Tooltip text" data-side="bottom" data-align="center">Hover</button>
tooltip.composition_rules: CSS-only: data-tooltip text on the trigger. data-side top|bottom|left|right|inline-start|inline-end; data-align start|center|end. Text only, no portal markup. Wrong: nest a separate tooltip span or invent aria-describedby portals like shadcn Tooltip.
